messages:
Zara Patel: Quick planning thread  we want a compact customer case to accompany next week's benchmark post. Deliverables: 15s social clip, 45s highlight video, 1-page PDF, and a slide for the webinar. Can we lock responsibilities?
Owen Li: I'll pull the validated benchmark deltas (cost per 1M tokens, P95/P99). ETA 3pm today.
Camila Ruiz: Happy to own copy and the one-pager. Also want the customer's preferred short quote and a localization note for FR/DE.
Zara Patel: Good point on localization. Tess  can marketing ops add a step for translated captions?
Tess Morgan: Yes. We'll add translated captions (FR/DE/ES) as optional assets. Need final transcript to send to localization vendor.
LegalBot: Consent reminder: customer must sign off on any pull quote and logo use. Use this consent template and capture signer name/title/date.
LegalBot: ```
I consent to Redwood Inference using my quote, company name, and logo in marketing materials for this product launch. I confirm these materials are not marked or designated as confidential.
```
Owen Li: Numbers uploaded to /files/benchmarks/launch-4123: token cost ~37% lower, P95 reduced by ~40ms, P99 improved ~120ms. Will add brief methodology note.
Camila Ruiz: Draft social pull: "Redwood made inference predictable and trimmed our costs  helped us ship faster." Open to edits.
Zara Patel: Let's keep social qualitative. Put the 37% stat in the one-pager and the blog.
Tess Morgan: Ops asks: what SFDC queue for demo requests? Also want a boolean form field for "interested_in_dedicated" to route leads.
Owen Li: Routing: demo -> SFDC ENT-501, dedicated interest -> AE-DED-12, press -> comms. I'll share the queue IDs in the launch doc.
Camila Ruiz: Customer requests to preview exact pull quote 24 hours before publish. Note that in the schedule.
LegalBot: Also redline: change "not marked or designated as confidential" to "not designated as confidential in writing" and add trademark approval line.
Zara Patel: Updated consent per LegalBot. Camila, please send final quote text to the customer by Tue 10am.
Camila Ruiz: Will do. Proposed final pull: "Redwood cut our inference costs and kept latency predictably low  allowed us to accelerate releases."
Owen Li: For tracking, add UTM params utm_campaign=bench_microcase&utm_source=social and a webhook to post demo leads to ENT-501 for testing.
OpsBot: Webhook created (test mode): https://hooks.redwood.ai/lead/ent-501. Hidden form field added: interested_in_dedicated=true/false.
Tess Morgan: Localization vendor needs the transcript by Wed noon. Can we record with captions on to speed up turnaround?
Camila Ruiz: We'll record with live captions and also capture a clean transcript. Recording scheduled Wed 2pm PT. Customer ok with that slot.
LegalBot: After customer signs, please email signed PDF to legal@redwood.ai and include signer name/title/timestamp. We'll log it.
PublishBot: Asset checklist created: 1) Copy + one-pager draft, 2) Signed consent, 3) Edited clips (15s & 45s), 4) Transcripts + captions, 5) Webinar slide. Checklist auto-triggers on consent upload.
Zara Patel: Final timeline: signoff Tue morning, record Wed 2pm PT, assets to design Wed night, publish Thu 11am PT. React with :white_check_mark: when your task is complete. Thanks all.
file_note: customer case + benchmark microcase: localization, consent, routing
